description: Get the 10 most recent Amazon reviews for a product: stars, title, text, date and verified-purchase flag, plus the overall rating. Reviewer names removed. Use it when: You need to know what real buyers say about a product before recommending it. Not for: Price or stock (use Amazon product data). Returns: Overall rating and rating count, and 10 reviews with stars, title, text, date and verified-purchase flag. No reviewer identities. Typical time: about 4 s. Price: $0.014 per product, charged only on success. One call = one page of reviews.

asin.description: The 10-character Amazon product ID (ASIN), e.g. B0BSHF7WHW
